Hi James —

Great to meet soon. Short answers to your questions: 

- SOC 2: A SOC 2 Type II report plus our Redwood_SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf is typically sufficient for a first pass. For very deep control narrative requests we can provide redacted control writeups but we try to minimize sharing internal docs until an NDA/ZIP is in place.
- SIG: Please send your SIG spreadsheet if convenient; we can also return a pre-filled file (attached) with our canned answers to speed review.
- Artifacts: SSO/IdP screenshots (Okta/GSuite), KMS integration high-level diagram and key rotation cadence, and logs retention (default 30 days for request logs; longer retention available via paid observability add-on). We can provide sanitized examples of access logs and a sample grep of audit events.

On the call we’ll cover where to upload artifacts (secure SharePoint/Drive link), owners for each item, and expected delivery timeline. I'm able to join the Mon 5/24 10:00 PT slot.

Action items I’ll bring to the call: short SOC 2 control summary, pre-filled SIG template, and suggested upload link.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
